notes.notes: We fixes some security vulnerabilities, and retired support for some CAD models.

notes.title: 1.22.0 Bug fix release
notes.notes: This update is a minor release. It contains several bug fixes. For further details, see the complete release notes.

notes.title: Modeler 1.21.0 Released
notes.notes: With this build, sculpting and primitive operations should feel noticeably more buttery smooth, as well as more Export Mode and Primitives workflow improvements.  A ground grid has also been added as an option and there are also many bug fixes.  Check out full release notes here:  https://helpx.adobe.com/substance-3d-modeler/release-notes/v1-21-release-notes.html

notes.title: Modeler 1.21.0
notes.notes: See release note here:  https://helpx.adobe.com/substance-3d-modeler/release-notes/v1-21-release-notes.html

notes.title: Modeler 1.19.0 Released
notes.notes: We've added an asset management to our Export mode.  Manage a Modeler scene as a collection of assets that can have different export settings and be exported as separate assets.  Lots of Primitive updates and other improvements as well.  See full release notes here:  https://helpx.adobe.com/substance-3d-modeler/release-notes/v1-19-release-notes.html

notes.title: 1.18 Release
notes.notes: See full release notes here.  Lots of improvements for primitives workflow and export:  https://helpx.adobe.com/substance-3d-modeler/release-notes/v1-18-release-notes.html

notes.title: Modeler 1.17 Released
notes.notes: We've updated our primitives workflow, added keyboard shortcuts UI (editing coming soon!), improved a lot of things with cameras, and more.  See full release notes here:  [url=https://helpx.adobe.com/substance-3d-modeler/release-notes/v1-17-release-notes.html]Release Notes[/url]

notes.title: Modeler continuing updates through 2025
notes.notes: Updates for Substance Modeler are being continued through 2025, so if you own Modeler 2024, it has been renamed to Modeler 2025 and you will get free updates.

notes.title: 1.15 Release: Primitives
notes.notes: We've added non-destructive primitives!  Right click to bring up the action menu and select "add primitive" to get started.  See the rest of the release notes here:  https://helpx.adobe.com/substance-3d-modeler/release-notes/v1-15-release-notes.html

notes.title: Logitech MX Ink Support
notes.notes: Modeler now supports the Logitech MX Ink 6 DOF Pen in VR mode

notes.title: Free updates through 2024!
notes.notes:
Hi everyone! 

We have some great news to share: Modeler free updates will continue all throughout 2024, at no extra cost! We have renamed the app to Substance Modeler 2024 to reflect this update.

notes.title: 1.3 Release
notes.notes: A lot of major improvements.  See release notes

Changes:
[list]
[*] Top bar menus now close automatically when they are no longer focused.
[/list]
Fixes:
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where importing a mesh and breaking it into submeshes could break save files.
[*] Fixed an issue where using the File menu could cause VR controls not to work properly.
[*] Improved handling for importing textured FBX files.
[/list]
